title: Hint response
description: Response of POST /api/v1/encounters/{id}/hints. Request body: { level, highest_level_asked? } where level is 1, 2 or 3 and highest_level_asked (0 to 3, default 0) is the highest level this player was already given for this encounter, passed in by the caller (Backend 2 knows the player). 1 is a nudge, 2 points at the approach, 3 is the walkthrough. Levels must be asked in order: a player can only ask for level N after asking levels 1 to N-1 (asking an already-asked level again is allowed and returns the same text). Errors: 404 if the encounter does not exist; 409 if level is more than highest_level_asked + 1 (body {"detail": "Ask hint level N first"}, N = highest_level_asked + 1); 422 if level is not 1 to 3 or highest_level_asked is not 0 to 3.
